summary: ATRenew Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 20, 2026, furnishing Exhibit 99.1 containing unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The China-based, NYSE-listed re-commerce company reported total net revenues of RMB6,609.3 million, up 32.4% year over year, with net income of RMB129.1 million and adjusted net income of RMB157.1 million, alongside 11.6 million consumer products transacted. Management commentary from Founder and CEO Kerry Xuefeng Chen and CFO Rex Chen addressed supply-chain execution and channel optimization. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
